actions.description: Remove the high tension: write the EHT control as 0 through the value manager; no input
actions.name: high_tension_off

outputs.description: True when the EHT control reads back as 0
outputs.name: high_tension_off

adjusts.description: Accelerating voltage, the EHT control in volts
adjusts.name: beam_voltage

adjusts.description: Defocus, the C10 control in meters
adjusts.name: defocus_m

adjusts.description: Energy offset, the ZLPoffset control in electron volts
adjusts.name: energy_offset_ev

facts.text: Instrument is constructed from an instrument id, a ValueManagerLike and an AxisManagerLike
TryGetVal reads a named control through value_manager.get_value and SetVal writes it through value_manager.set_value
The voltage property reads the EHT control with GetVal and writes it with SetVal
The defocus_m property reads the C10 control with GetVal and writes it with SetVal
The energy_offset_eV property reads the ZLPoffset control with GetVal and writes it with SetVal
get_electrons_per_pixel reads BeamCurrent and multiplies it by 1E12 to obtain picoamperes, so the stored control is in amperes
max_defocus is set in __init__ and _set_config_property accepts it (and stage_size_nm) as a configuration property, so it is a configurable attribute and not a fixed instrument bound

measures.description: Beam current, the BeamCurrent control in amperes (the unit get_electrons_per_pixel uses)
measures.name: beam_current_a

operator_required.name: beam_voltage
operator_required.reason: the clone names the EHT control but states no accelerating-voltage range (nion/device_kit/InstrumentDevice.py:155-161); the range depends on the column and the high-voltage supply of the deployed instrument and is supplied by the operator

operator_required.name: defocus_m
operator_required.reason: the clone exposes the defocus through C10 and a configurable max_defocus attribute, not a fixed range (nion/device_kit/InstrumentDevice.py:69-86, 147-153); the lens range of the deployed instrument is supplied by the operator

operator_required.name: energy_offset_ev
operator_required.reason: the clone names the ZLPoffset control but states no energy range (nion/device_kit/InstrumentDevice.py:164-171); the range of the deployed energy filter is supplied by the operator

safe_state.description: high tension off: the EHT control is written as 0 through the instrument value manager
